advisory_text:
PERINGATAN KUALITAS UDARA — Bukit / Fab Lab Bali
Sensor warga menunjukkan PM2.5 sekitar 45 µg/m³, di atas ambang komunitas 35 µg/m³. Kelompok rentan (anak-anak, lansia, ibu hamil, penderita asma/jantung) sebaiknya mengurangi aktivitas di luar dan memakai masker (N95/KN95 bila ada). Tutup jendela dan nyalakan penyaring udara di dalam ruangan jika tersedia.

AIR QUALITY ADVISORY — Bukit / Fab Lab Bali
Community sensors show PM2.5 around 45 µg/m³, above the community threshold of 35 µg/m³. Vulnerable groups (children, the elderly, pregnant people, those with asthma/heart conditions) should limit outdoor activity and wear a well-fitting mask (N95/KN95 if available). Close windows and run an indoor air filter if you have one.
